# Handelsblatt interviews Christopher Bogart about business in Germany


November 5, 2025


-
-
-
-


*Handelsblatt* features an interview with CEO[Christopher Bogart](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/christopher-bogart/) , where he discusses Burford's presence in Germany. Bogart says: "Germany is our largest market in Europe. We’ve been active here for more than ten years and work closely with German companies."


Read the full article[here](https://www.handelsblatt.com/finanzen/steuern-recht/recht/recht-zu-viele-klagen-in-den-usa-nur-um-einen-vergleich-zu-erzwingen/100166011.html) .
